effects: Moves `amount` of the vault collateral (SolvBTC for 0x249a…, read from the init data) from the signer to the vault via safeTransferFrom, spending the signer's allowance to the vault.
Mints active vault shares (previewDeposit of the amount received) to `onBehalfOf`, which then holds the slashable stake position.
Reverts if a deposit whitelist is on and the signer is not on it, or if the deposit limit would be passed.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 SolvBTC into the named vault, with the shares going to the named beneficiary.

findings.title: deposit: number of vault shares minted to onBehalfOf is not shown; it is computed from vault storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_); _activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...)`; descriptor shows only #.amount and #.onBehalfOf.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata; the beneficiary field already names the holder of the new position.

findings.title: deposit/withdraw: SolvBTC token constant also used for deployment 0x7797…1548, whose collateral could not be verified.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.underlyingToken = 0x7A56E1C5… used for both deployments; collateral is read from storage (`IERC20(collateral)`); only 0x249a…'s init data (collateral 0x7a56e1c5…) is available; case 1 shows '123.25 SolvBTC' for 0x7797….
findings.fix: Confirm 0x7797…1548 has collateral() == 0x7A56E1C5…; if not, put it in a separate descriptor with its own token constant.

effects: Burns enough of the signer's active shares to cover `amount` of collateral (rounded up), lowering the signer's stake position.
Gives `claimer` withdrawal shares for epoch currentEpoch+1. Only the claimer can claim that `amount` of SolvBTC after the epoch ends, and it can still be slashed until then.
No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: Request a 2.5 SolvBTC withdrawal for the named claim owner from the named vault.

findings.title: withdraw: intent does not say the claimer, not the signer, gets the right to the funds after an epoch delay.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: `withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares` with `epoch = currentEpoch() + 1`; _claim reads `withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)`. Descriptor: intent 'Request withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Request {amount} withdrawal for {claimer}'.
findings.fix: Use e.g. 'Withdraw {amount} from your stake; claimable by {claimer} after the next epoch'.

findings.title: withdraw: number of shares burned from the signer is derived from storage and not shown.
findings.fix: None; the asset amount is shown.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Gives `claimer` withdrawal shares worth previewRedeem(shares) SolvBTC for epoch currentEpoch+1, which only the claimer can claim after that epoch ends.
No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: Queue 987654321123456789 raw vault shares for withdrawal to the named claim owner.

findings.title: redeem: share amount is shown as a raw 18-digit integer instead of a scaled unit.
findings.evidence: descriptor field #.shares format 'raw'; case 3 shows '987654321123456789'; ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares have the collateral's 18 decimals.
findings.fix: Use format 'unit' with params {base: 'shares', decimals: 18}, or the equivalent, to show '0.9877 shares'.

findings.title: redeem: the SolvBTC amount queued for the claimer is computed from storage and is not shown.
findings.fix: None from calldata; the intent could still name SolvBTC as the asset.

findings.title: redeem: intent does not say the claimer, not the signer, can claim the funds later.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw `withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares`; interpolatedIntent 'Queue {shares} raw shares for {claimer}'.
findings.fix: Use e.g. 'Withdraw {shares} vault shares; SolvBTC claimable by {claimer} after the next epoch'.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
Moves withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) of SolvBTC from the vault to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal for epoch 42 to the named recipient.

findings.title: claim: the asset received (SolvBTC) is not named in the intent or any field.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`; descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Use e.g. 'Claim SolvBTC withdrawal for epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the amount paid out comes from the signer's withdrawal shares in storage, not from calldata.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed.
Moves the sum of withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) over all listed epochs, in SolvBTC, from the vault to `recipient` in one transfer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals for epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the named recipient.

findings.title: claimBatch: the asset received (SolvBTC) is not named in the intent or any field.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`; descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawals', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Use e.g. 'Claim SolvBTC withdrawals for epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total paid out is the sum of the signer's withdrawals in storage, not from calldata.
